title: Banner Patterns
blurb: Patterns used at a loom to apply special designs to banners. A pattern item is kept in the pattern slot and is not consumed when crafting.
note: Tier A. Component rule on minecraft:provides_banner_patterns selected over a list because it re-derives itself on every build. Exactly 10 items carry this component in 26.2, representing the full set of physical pattern items; the other 33 banner_pattern registry entries require no item and are crafted directly from dyes at the loom. Icon borrowed from the Loom.
